title: SSE buf: split_off on every frame allocates a new String
description: client.rs subscribe_events: on each frame, buf.split_off(pos + delim_len) allocates a new String for the suffix and leaves buf as the frame. Then buf = suffix reassigns. This means every frame boundary triggers a heap allocation. For high-throughput SSE streams (many small state-change frames), this is an allocation per frame. An alternative is to maintain a single buffer with a read cursor and drain the consumed prefix periodically, avoiding per-frame allocation. Not critical for typical JMAP usage (low frame rate) but worth noting.
